capabilities: Create Substack drafts from notes with title, subtitle, formatted body, and images
Publish notes or selected text excerpts to the Substack Notes feed
Upload local embedded images to the newsletter before creating a draft
Connect, switch, and disconnect Substack accounts, including manual session setup
Prepare language editions of drafts for supported languages
extras: Uses Substack's undocumented API, so Substack changes may break the connection, draft creation, or Note publication; the plugin is unofficial and not reviewed by Obsidian staff; mobile sign-in requires manual session setup and the mobile workflow is unvalidated; it is an independent plugin by Thierry Crouzet.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send a note to Substack as a newsletter draft or a Note in the Notes feed.

relations.evidence: Write in Obsidian, choose your newsletter, and create a Substack draft with your title, subtitle, formatted text, and images.

summary: Publishing tool that turns an Obsidian note into a Substack draft or Note, keeping formatting and uploading embedded images.
